entries: What is this that enters my lair? Humans?
闯入我巢穴的是什么？人类？
Enough of this talk. Let us crush this vermin.
废话少说。碾碎这只虫豸。
Finally, a sliver of wisdom. Regardless, you will all die here.
总算有一丝明智之言。然而，你们全都会死在这里。
Tale and song make no mention of you, despite your claim to greatness.
传说与歌谣从未提起过你，尽管你自称伟大。
It looks like it has plenty of eyes to me.
That is because I am older than both, mortal.
那是因为我比二者都古老，凡人。
Alliance against your kind grows. Not only humans.
对抗你们这类东西的联盟正在壮大。不止是人类。
Such simple minds... Nothing stays a child forever, except perhaps the human race. No, I am much more than his child now.
如此简单的头脑……没有什么能永远当孩子，也许人类除外。不，如今的我远不止是「他的孩子」。
I am looking forward to crushing you, Neladra.
我很期待碾碎你，内德拉拉。
Friends, we boast well, but can we back it up with action?
朋友们，我们嘴上说得漂亮，可行动能不能跟上？
So this is the child of the dark lord?
这就是黑暗领主的孩子？
Does look human? Need new eyes.
看着像人类？得换双新眼睛了。
